pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are organized in a polygonal tessellation, exhibiting irregular quadrilateral and hexagonal geometries. Edges show smooth pixel gradients with low-contrast transitions. Patches on the mid-flank possess a larger spatial area relative to those on the posterior hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways separates the dark patches. The topology is characterized by junction nodes consisting mostly of trivalent intersections. The pixel width of these corridors remains relatively uniform across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the superior neck and shoulder presents as a short, dark vertical fringe. The 1D geometric contour displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background.
